column1: # What this repository may still carry of the two shapes quality_test.go measures: the functions of one
# file that are longer than sixty lines, and the exported names nothing calls. Every number here may
# Sixty rather than forty: the tree carries 185 functions over forty lines across 36k lines of Go, so a
# forty-line budget would be a list of ninety numbers rather than a guard. Sixty is where length stops
# being a style question, and it is the shape that reads as generated — a body that absorbed every
# branch its author met instead of calling something.
# There is no unused-export entry because there are no unused exports: the rule reports a name the tree
# never names twice, and memHeap's Less and Swap are methods, which a name index cannot see called and
# which this rule therefore does not count. An entry added here is dead code to delete, not a budget.
